title: THE FORGE: A DROPPED FORGED GUN STAYS FORGED
why: His idea of 2026-10-12: upgrade guns at the Forge, and keep what you extract with. A gun you drop from the backpack used to come back out of the pile at plain field grade (so a drop could never be used to re-roll a gun). An upgraded gun now keeps its MK and its element through the pile: drop your MK III and take it back, or leave it for your teammate in co-op, and it is still a MK III. A plain gun still comes back at field grade, as before.
now: A forged gun dropped on the ground keeps its upgrade when picked up again.
